title: Create a second score variable
description: Save 10 in a variable named score. Create a different variable named score1 and store score + 5 in it. Print score1. The answer should be 15, and score should stay 10.
explanation: score stores 10. score1 is a new variable, so score1 = score + 5 stores 15 without changing score. print(score1) displays 15.
commonMistakes: Use two different variable names: score and score1. Writing score = score + 5 updates the original score variable; this task asks you to create score1 and print score1.

validation.feedback: Create a second variable from the first one, then print the new variable.
